coeffs.description: A list of `Tensor` representing the coefficients of the polynomial.
constraints: coeffs must be a list of tensors.

x.description: A `Tensor` representing the variable of the polynomial.
constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes when evaluating p(x).

output.description: A `tensor` of the shape as the expression p(x) with usual broadcasting rules for element-wise addition and multiplication applied. @compatibility(numpy) Equivalent to numpy.polyval. @end_compatibility
